Hi all — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. He's away this week and asked me to arrange the **CSE455 staff meeting for next week** (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov).

His calendar is packed, so the only windows inside 09:00–17:00 that don't push anything else out of the way are:

- Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30
